in_marathi.name: Chinmayei
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Consciousness of the Absolute
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chinmayei हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chinmayei is derived from the Sanskrit words 'chinmaya' which means 'consciousness of the Absolute' and 'ei' meaning 'she'. This name symbolizes the deep spiritual understanding and connection to the divine. Chinmayei is a name for a girl who is wise, compassionate and has a strong spiritual foundation.
